name: Zorvex Widgets for Elementor
author: Helal Uddin

sections.description:
Zorvex Widgets for Elementor extends Elementor with a modular collection of widgets and a centralized dashboard where administrators can enable or disable individual widgets.

Included widgets:

  • 3D Flip Button
  • Slice Button
  • Creative Heading
  • Creative Text Editor
  • Number Box
  • Menu Icon

The plugin registers widget assets only when Elementor requests them and does not include tracking, advertising, or remote service calls.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Elementor.
  2. Upload the zorvex-widgets-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin ZIP from Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate Zorvex Widgets for Elementor.
  4. Open Zorvex Widgets for Elementor in the WordPress admin menu to enable or disable widgets.
  5. Edit a page with Elementor and locate the Zorvex Widgets for Elementor widget category.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes. Elementor must be installed and activated to use the widgets.

Can individual widgets be disabled?

Yes. Open the Zorvex Widgets for Elementor dashboard and use the Widget Manager.

Does the plugin send data to external services?

No. The plugin contains no analytics, tracking, advertising, or remote API calls.
